tagline: Kowa胶片单反相机，1961 年发布
description: Kowa于1961年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度Seikosha SLV leaf shutter with a range of 1 sec to 1/500th plus B.。使用180° lever.。感光度10 to 1600 ASA.。Pentaprism with condenser, Fresnel lens, and split image rangefinder.。

specs.对焦: Pentaprism with condenser, Fresnel lens, and split image rangefinder.
specs.快门: Seikosha SLV leaf shutter with a range of 1 sec to 1/500th plus B.
specs.曝光测光: Fully manual with viewfinder match needle.
specs.闪光灯: M and X contact, and an accessory shoe mounting port on the right side of (i.e. not on top of) the top plate (facing). This was an L shaped bracket, that positioned a cold shoe above the rewind crank.
specs.尺寸: 143 x 97 x 87mm (W x H x D).
specs.英文简介: The Kowa E (which appears to have been branded as the Kowaflex E in the USA) was the base model for subsequent Kowa 35mm SLR cameras.
